We are looking for a skilled Photo Editor to work with our team on a per-photo / per-project basis to start. If things go well and we begin getting a high volume of work together, this position can grow into a full-time role.

We need someone who can confidently edit real estate photography, food photography, and occasionally people/portrait photos.

You should have a strong eye for detail, know how to make images look clean and professional, and understand how to edit for different styles depending on the subject.

Experience editing real estate photos

Experience editing food photos

Able to edit people/portraits when needed

Strong knowledge of Adobe Lightroom

Familiar with tools/software such as Auto HDR and other editing tools

Strong understanding of the fundamentals of photo editing, including:

color correction

white balance

exposure

contrast

masking

natural-looking retouching



Able to keep edits looking clean and natural, not overdone

Can maintain a consistent editing style across a full gallery

Good communication and able to follow editing references

Important:



We are open to editors who use AI tools or other helpful software, but you must understand the fundamentals first. Tools are welcome, but we need someone who knows how to properly edit a photo, not someone who only depends on automatic edits or presets.

We will start by paying per photo or per project

This is a good fit for someone who wants to build a working relationship first

If we end up working well together and the workload increases, there is an opportunity to move into a full-time position

Bonus if you have experience with:

HDR blending

Window pulls for real estate

Sky replacements

Object removal

Food color enhancement and cleanup

Skin tone correction and light retouching

Your portfolio

Examples of real estate, food, and portrait/people editing

The software and tools you use

Your rates for per-photo or per-project work

Your turnaround time

title: Sales and Onboarding
description:
Sales & Onboarding Specialist (SaaS) — Full-Time, AU Hours, Long-Term



Be the first friendly voice new customers hear — then help them go live. Full training provided (no software or NDIS experience needed).



ABOUT US — Sentinel HR is an Australian software company that helps disability and aged-care providers stay compliant and keep their workforce audit-ready. Our whole reason for existing is peace of mind. This is a long-term, stable role where the work you do genuinely helps protect vulnerable people's care.



THE ROLE — You'll be the first person new customers talk to: call fresh leads fast, have a warm chat, book and run demos, then help each new customer get set up and live. Michael (the founder) will personally train you on the sales side — if you're coachable, reliable and great on the phone, we'll teach you the rest.



WHAT YOU'LL DO — Sales: call every lead within ~5 minutes · run a 1-minute qualifying call (3–5 questions) · book (or roll straight into) a discovery call · run discovery · deliver a tailored demo + proposal ("Expo + Offer") · follow up on a 6-touch cadence · keep the CRM tidy.



Onboarding: coordinate data migration with our VA team · guide setup to "live & audit-ready" fast · be the friendly point of contact · hand over cleanly to support.



MUST HAVE: clear, warm spoken English (phone-heavy) · calm talking to business owners · fast internet (share speedtest) · quiet space + good headset · coachable · self-driven · detail-oriented · happy on AU daytime hours (no graveyard).



NICE TO HAVE (not required): any sales/cold-calling/appointment-setting/CS experience · CRM/SaaS tools · Western clients · healthcare/aged-care/NDIS exposure.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Lead)

_Partner with cross-functional teams and, where needed, mentor junior QA tea
mbers.

? Be 18+

The ideal candidate is someone who wants to grow with an original animated series—not someone looking for a one-time freelance project.

title: Full-Time FRENCH SPEAKING Video Editor & Content Operator for Premium Leadership Communication Brand
description:
About Demoria



Demoria is a French speaking premium leadership and communication training company helping founders, executives, and senior professionals become clearer, more trusted, and more powerful communicators.



We create high-quality educational content around leadership, trust, communication, persuasion, presence, decision-making, and speaking under pressure.



We are looking for a FRENCH SPEAKING full-time remote video editor and content operator to join us long-term.



This is not a low-level editing role where you simply cut clips together. We are looking for someone with strong taste, excellent reliability, and the ability to help turn raw footage into polished, premium content.



You will work closely with the founders and help us build a serious content engine across YouTube, short-form video, and social media.



This Role Is For Someone Who Thinks Like an Editor, Not Just a Cutter



We do not want generic edits, loud effects, cheap transitions, or “viral” editing that damages trust.



Our brand needs to feel premium, elegant, intelligent, calm, and authoritative.



You should understand how to make educational content engaging without making it look cheap.



You should be able to take long-form footage and identify:



what the strongest moments are

what should become a full YouTube video

what should become a short-form clip

what should be cut, tightened, or restructured

where pacing is too slow

where the message needs more clarity

how to make the final piece feel polished, premium, and trustworthy

What You’ll Do

Long-Form Video Editing



You will edit long-form YouTube videos, usually between 15 and 50 minutes.



These may include:



educational videos

leadership communication lessons

talking-head videos

training excerpts

podcast-style discussions

webinar or programme material

founder-led thought leadership content



You will be expected to improve:



pacing

structure

clarity

sound quality

visual polish

viewer retention

emotional flow

overall premium feel



You should know how to keep a video engaging without over-editing it.



Short-Form Content



You will repurpose long-form footage into short-form clips for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and LinkedIn.



This includes:



identifying strong moments from long-form footage

creating 30–90 second short-form clips

adding clean captions/subtitles

creating strong opening hooks

maintaining brand consistency

avoiding cheap, noisy, overdone editing styles



The short-form content should feel sharp, intelligent, and premium — not gimmicky.



Content Management & Publishing Support



You will help manage the content workflow from raw footage to publication.



This may include:



organising raw footage

naming and storing files clearly

maintaining a content calendar

preparing video exports

uploading/scheduling content

writing or formatting basic titles/descriptions

preparing subtitle files

tracking what is completed, in progress, and blocked

keeping our video library organised



You must be very organised. We do not want to chase you for updates.



Basic Graphic Design



You should be able to create or support simple visual assets such as:



YouTube thumbnails

clean title cards

simple social graphics

branded templates

course/video covers

basic carousel-style assets



We are not looking for loud influencer design. We want refined, clean, premium visuals.



Experience with Canva, Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, or similar tools is useful.



AI-Assisted Workflow



You should be comfortable using AI tools to work faster and better.



Useful tools may include:



Descript

ChatGPT

Claude

CapCut

Runway

ElevenLabs

Midjourney

Canva AI

Adobe AI tools

OpusClip or similar clipping tools

transcription and subtitle tools



You do not need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be curious, efficient, and willing to test better workflows.



We care about quality first. AI should improve the work, not make it generic.



Monthly Output



The expected monthly workload will usually include:



4–8 long-form videos per month

short-form clips repurposed from long-form footage

social media/content management

basic thumbnail or graphic support

organisation of footage and project files



The exact output will depend on the complexity of each video.



Quality matters more than rushing.



We’re Looking For Someone Who

has strong French language skills

has strong experience editing long-form YouTube or educational content

understands talking-head, expert, podcast, or training-style video

can edit for clarity, authority, and retention

has strong short-form editing skills

has good taste and understands premium branding

can create clean captions and subtitles

has basic graphic design ability

is highly organised and reliable

communicates clearly in written English

can meet deadlines without constant chasing

can work independently after receiving clear direction

can overlap with European working hours several times per week

is comfortable working remotely

wants a long-term role, not just short-term freelance projects



Bonus Skills



These are not required, but they will make your application stronger:



experience editing leadership, business, education, coaching, or expert content

experience with YouTube retention editing

experience creating YouTube thumbnails

experience using analytics to improve content

experience with LinkedIn content

experience with online courses or digital education brands

experience with Notion, Trello, ClickUp, or similar project management tools

motion graphics or After Effects

podcast editing

audio cleanup

experience with premium/luxury/editorial brands



What We Do Not Want



Please do not apply if your style is mainly:



loud influencer edits

cheap transitions

excessive sound effects

random zooms every two seconds

overused viral templates

messy captions

low-quality audio

disorganised file delivery

missed deadlines

needing to be chased constantly



Our content should feel intelligent, clear, premium, and trustworthy.



Compensation & Logistics

Strong French language skills

Full-time remote role

Starting salary: $1,200–$1,500/month depending on experience

Long-term position with room to grow

40 hours per week

Must be able to overlap with European working hours several times per week

Paid trial task required before final selection

Trial month before long-term confirmation

How To Apply



To apply, please send all of the following.



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.



A long-form video edit you are proud of

A short-form video edit you are proud of

A thumbnail or graphic design example

A short note explaining why this role interests you

A short note explaining what you understand about Demoria from our website/social content

A list of the editing/design/AI tools you use regularly

Your internet speed and computer specifications

Your availability and earliest start date

Your expected monthly salary

Your
 address and WhatsApp number



Please start your application with this sentence:



“I edit for clarity, trust, and retention.”



This helps us know you have read the full job description.



Trial Task



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid trial task.



The trial task will include:



editing a short section of long-form footage

creating one short-form clip from the same footage

suggesting one possible title or hook

showing how you organise the project files



We are looking for quality, judgment, organisation, and reliability — not just speed.

description:
**About me**



I'm an independent artist working across multiple music projects (a band and a solo project), plus I do freelance music production for other artists. I'm looking for a long-term assistant who can help reduce overwhelm, keep things organised, and support the creative workflow — especially TikTok content and community management.



I already have a dedicated video editor who handles the heavy footage work. This role is about everything else in the content and community chain — TikTok creation, Instagram posting, DMs, and keeping my world organised.



---



**What you'll do**



**TikTok Content Creation (the biggest part)**



- I send you selfie videos and iPhone footage. You cut them into multiple short clips, mute the original audio, and drop the correct song section over the top. You'll make multiple versions from the same source and keep track so we don't reuse the same clip too many times. You need to be organised and on top of what works best.

- Take song sections (verse, chorus, bridge etc.) and pair them with the best visual moments

- Edit scenes from films / series to match our tracks, add lyrics where they fit

- Organise finished clips into A/B test folders (e.g. flagship_july_2026)

- Upload to our shared Google Drive in the right structure

- CapCut editing is the baseline — any extra editing skills (Premiere, DaVinci, After Effects) are a big bonus but not required



**Instagram Management**



- Post our content directly on the Instagram app when I ping you with the asset + copy (native posting, not scheduling)

- DM new followers with a specific welcome message (to a capped number of people, not everyone). You need to avoid industry people — managers, journalists, other musicians — and only message genuine fans. Fluent English is essential so you can judge who is who.

- Engage with comments in our brand voice

- Cold DM outreach to fans of similar bands using templates I provide (fans only, needs to feel human)



**Music Platform Admin**



- Upload Spotify Canvas videos

- Sync and match lyrics on Musixmatch (and Genius if possible)

- Basic Bandcamp upkeep

- Tag TikTok videos in our backend system (MoonOS) so we know what song is used and what copy is on the screen



**YouTube**



- Create and upload videos from my backlog of YouTube-ready content

- Keep the channel active with what we already have



**Organisation & Admin**



- Own the Trello board — keep it updated, move cards, flag blockers

- Help with light invoicing and payment tracking (training provided)

- General research when needed

- Monthly clean-up so nothing builds up



**Optional / Down the line**



- Set up Shopify listings for merch when we have photos and details

- Help with MoonOS data uploads and clip tagging

- Assist with solo project and production outreach once I'm ready to take on more work

- Festival and show organisation help — sending
s, chasing details, coordinating logistics (not the applications themselves, but the admin around them)



---



**What this is not**



- You won't be doing heavy video editing (our editor handles GoPro Max, colour grading, world/dome shots in DaVinci Resolve) — though if you have those skills they're a bonus

- You won't be doing festival applications directly — that stays with me, but organisational help around them is very welcome

- You won't be running music press or industry relationships from day one — that grows with trust and time

- This isn't a corporate role. I want someone who talks like a human, not a brand guidelines document



---



**Tools you'll use**



CapCut, Google Drive, Trello, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Bandcamp, Spotify for Artists, Musixmatch, MoonOS (our internal tracker — easy to learn)



---



**Who you are**



- You're reliable. You show up, you communicate, you don't ghost for days without warning

- You're proactive. If something's missing, you ask. If something's broken, you flag it

- You write in natural, casual English. No corporate language, no AI-sounding fluff

- You can work independently but also take direction without needing hand-holding

- You're organised. If your Google Drive looks like a bomb site, this isn't for you

- You have a good eye for what works on TikTok. You understand pacing, hooks, and when a clip is too long

- You actually like music — indie, alternative, or folk especially. Not "I listen to everything" — you have opinions



---



**How to apply**



Keep it short and specific. I won't read essays.



Tell me:



1. Your experience with TikTok/Reels editing (links to work if you have them)

2. What music you're actually into (be specific — bands, artists, genres)

3. Your availability and timezone

4. A quick note on why you're reliable and won't disappear after two weeks

5. Your hourly rate



If your message looks copy-pasted, I won't reply. Tell me something real.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Project Based - AI Remote Systems & Automations
description:
Title: AI Platform & Product Operations Lead

Schedule: n/a, 1-4 monthly syn meeting between 9 AM–5 PM ETT GREECE

Hours: 50 Hours Monthly

Rate of Pay: $800 - $950 a month (Rate of Pay $16-$19 USD)



This role will begin by auditing and strengthening the business’s internal technical ecosystem, with a focus on creating a robust customer funnel tracking system from awareness to sales. Once that foundation is in place, the role will expand into building a client-facing platform that allows our clients to track their own business inputs and outputs, supported by dashboards, AI tools, trainings, and strategic resources



Self Made is a premier global business consultancy and transformation platform dedicated to building a new generation of successful female entrepreneurs. We provide established female founders and service-based business owners with a strategic roadmap combined with modern marketing strategy, tool integration, and community resources to create true leverage, profitability, and operational freedom. Our comprehensive approach explicitly addresses both technical growth requirements and the deeper professional confidence challenges that arise during business scaling. Guided by an absolute commitment to excellence in execution, we exist to help brilliant women combine their lifelong expertise with contemporary rules of visibility to achieve wealth and impact on their own terms



Accountability: Phase 1

*Technical ecosystem audit

- Review the full business tech stack across CRM,
, payments, forms, automations, analytics, content platforms, and Airtable

- Map how leads currently move from awareness to enquiry to sale

- Identify data gaps, broken handoffs, duplicate tools, and manual workarounds

- Assess which systems are reliable enough to keep and which need replacing or restructuring

- Document the current-state architecture in a way that is clear and usable



*Funnel tracking and measurement

- Build a robust way to track the customer journey from awareness through to conversion

- Define the key funnel stages and what each one means in your business

- Establish the core metrics to measure at each stage

- Create logic for tracking lead source, conversion points, sales activity, and customer movement

- Make sure the data can be viewed consistently and updated accurately



*Systems integration and data structure

- Connect the key systems needed to support clean funnel visibility

- Improve how Airtable is used as a source of truth where relevant

- Consolidate fragmented data from Stripe, School, and Kit into a single Airtable relational database, establishing a unified

Source of Truth with zero duplicate records within the first 30 days.

- Ensure data flows correctly between tools and is structured for long-term use

- Reduce fragmentation across platforms

- Create a setup that can later support a client-facing dashboard



*Operational visibility and reporting

- Build internal reporting views that allow you to clearly see business performance

- Create dashboards or views for sales pipeline, leads, content performance, and conversion trends

- Make reporting practical and decision-focused, not just data-heavy

- Ensure reporting supports fast insight into what is and is not working



*Documentation and implementation standards

- Document the systems, workflows, tracking logic, and definitions

- Create SOPs for ongoing maintenance and team use

- Establish standards for naming, permissions, and data hygiene

- Build the setup so it can be maintained and expanded over time



Phase 2:

*Client platform design

- Translate the internal system into a client-facing experience

- Design how clients will track both input and output in their business

- Structure a performance dashboard so it is simple, strategic, and useful

- Ensure the platform helps clients understand performance and take action



*Client business tracking framework

- Build a model clients can use to track their own awareness, leads, sales activity, and growth

- Define which inputs they should monitor, such as content, outreach, offers, and sales actions

- Define which outputs they should monitor, such as leads, inbound requests, calls booked, deals closed, and revenue

- Make sure the framework is easy to use and relevant for coaching clients



*AI and strategic tools integration

- Integrate useful AI-supported tools into the client experience

- Build access to competitor research workflows

- Include transcription and summary features for content and learning

- Create access to custom GPTs or guided AI tools for idea development and execution support

- Ensure AI tools are practical, safe, and well-structured for client use



*Training and guided implementation

- Link the dashboard experience to trainings, resources, and strategic guidance

- Build a systemised checklist approach to business building inside the platform

- Make sure clients know what to do next based on their current business data

- Connect education to execution so the platform drives action, not just insight



*Events and client engagement

- Build a calendar view for upcoming events, trainings, and key touchpoints

- Make the platform feel like an active business-growth environment rather than a static portal

- Support client engagement through visibility, reminders, and structured planning



*Scale, quality, and long-term platform ownership

- Ensure the platform is built for long-term use, not quick fixes

- Create a permissions structure that protects client data appropriately

- Maintain data quality, usability, and reliability as the platform grows

- Identify future improvements and help shape the long-term product roadmap

- Design and execute a production-ready client interface through reliable API/Zapier schemas engineered to support 100–500 active concurrent users without system lag or handoff breakage.



Tasks:

*Review and optimise our systems daily to ensure the customer journey from awareness to sale is clear, effective, and scalable.

*Track and report on key business metrics, turning data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

*Build and maintain the operational infrastructure of the business, including Airtable, automations, integrations, and SOPs.

*Approach problems with clear structure and strategic thinking, turning ideas and gaps into practical solutions

*Communicate progress through daily updates, keeping the founder informed on wins, issues, priorities, and next actions.



Expectations:

*3+ years in operations, systems, product operations, business intelligence, or digital product implementation

*Hands-on experience with Airtable and connected tools

*Experience setting up or improving reporting dashboards and data flows

*Experience building or managing automations and integrations

*Experience documenting processes and creating scalable workflows

*Experience giving clear updates, recommendations, and next steps to a founder or senior decision-maker

*Experience building robust, scalable digital platforms for long-term use, with a clear understanding of clean system architecture, reliability, and user experience at scale. Must be able to create proper production-ready systems rather than quick, patchwork, or vibe-coded solutions, with the ability to support at least 100 active users.

*Must be highly detail-oriented and take pride in excellence of execution, with a consistent ability to deliver clean, accurate, high-quality work to a very high standard. Secret Code = SMAI0702

*Must be highly self-motivated, take initiative, and work with a high level of independence and should be able to understand the wider vision, think proactively, and bring ideas, improvements, and solutions to the table.

title: CAD Engineer
description:
The client designs and manufactures engine-mounted compressor and alternator drive kits, mounting brackets

and related components for refrigerated transport. The CAD engineer reverse-engineers, designs and details

these parts so they can be manufactured and fitted correctly first time, and delivers all design data into

the client's ownership in editable form. The role covers laser-cut steel brackets, machined components and

castings, along with the assembly drawings, bills of material, exploded views and fitting manuals that go with

them.



Output drives real production and customer fitment, so fit, dimensional accuracy and clear, manufacturable

drawings matter more than speed.



Inputs (what the engineer receives)



? A Ramair part number (RMxxxx) issued before any new part is started, with the part modelled, drawn and

filed to that number.

? A design brief covering the application: compressor or alternator model, belt arrangement, pulley

specification, mounting interface, target vehicle or engine, and the product line it belongs to (for example a

Euro 6 variant, an alternator mount kit, or a TCCI QP30 conversion).

? 3D scan data of the target engine, compressor or vehicle interface, supplied as raw scan or mesh, to

design the part around.

? Physical or in-production samples, photographs and hand measurements where a scan is not available or

needs confirming.

? Reference material: existing similar kits, the relevant native files (DXF or Parasolid) from the Engineering

Folder for revisions, prior BOMs and install guides.

? Component and interface specifications: compressor mounting patterns, pulley dimensions, fastener

standards, and any supplier constraints from the laser cutter, machinist or foundry.

? Ramair drawing templates (A4 and A3), title blocks and the part numbering convention.

Activities (the work expected)

? Clean and interpret 3D scan data into usable reference geometry for design.

? Design laser-cut brackets, machined parts (drive pulleys, fan spacers, spacer blocks) and castings,

modelled in 3D and built to be edited and revised cleanly.

? Engineer the spacer stack, compressor or alternator position, pulley plane and belt alignment so the

assembly is correct and serviceable.

? Produce manufacturing data in the correct format for each part type, as set out under Outputs.

? Create detail drawings with full dimensions, tolerances, materials, finishes and machining operations.

? Create general assembly drawings showing what goes where, with spacer diameters and lengths called

out explicitly.

? Generate bills of material and exploded views, and produce graphics for assembly and fitting manuals.

? Apply design-for-manufacture judgement and resolve queries with suppliers so parts are made without

avoidable back-and-forth.

? Incorporate changes found during first production or sample checks, and keep every revision controlled.

? Maintain and tidy the Ramair drawing templates, fastener and part libraries and naming, improving them

over time.

? Over time, support two programmes: re-mastering the existing active range into clean editable models,

and digitising newly acquired product ranges.



CAD Engineer | Role description



Outputs (what the engineer delivers)



For every part, the editable native CAD and the matching PDF, delivered into the Ramair Engineering Folder

under the assigned RM number, never as a sole copy held elsewhere.



? Laser-cut brackets: individual DXF files for cutting, a detail drawing (PDF) for each, and a general

assembly or detail drawing (PDF) for manufacture and assembly.

? Castings: two Parasolid models, machined and unmachined, a detail drawing (PDF) for machining

operations and tolerances, and a general assembly drawing (PDF).

? Machined items (drive pulleys, fan spacers, spacer blocks): a Parasolid 3D model and a detail

drawing (PDF).

? Assemblies: a 3D assembly model, a bill of material in a structured format (spreadsheet or CSV), and

exploded views (PDF or image, with the source assembly file retained).

? Manuals: exploded views and step graphics suitable for assembly and fitting instructions, generated once

a design is tested and finalised.

? Revision control: CAD and PDF always issued at the same matched revision, with a short changelog

noting what changed.



Where the working software allows, the parametric source file is delivered as well as the neutral formats, so

Ramair holds fully editable design data.



Quality criteria



Good looks like



? The part fits first time. Mounting points, interface to the scanned geometry, belt alignment and pulley

planes are all correct.

? The spacer stack is fully resolved, with spacer diameters and lengths stated clearly and correctly. This is

the single most common failure point and must be right.

? Drawings are unambiguous, fully dimensioned and toleranced sensibly, and the part can be made exactly

as drawn.

? Tolerances are appropriate to function, tight where it matters and open where it does not, so cost is not

driven up needlessly.

? CAD and PDF match at the same revision every time, filed correctly to the RM number with native files

included.

? Models are clean and structured so the next change is quick to make.

? Exploded views and manual graphics are clear enough to fit from without guesswork.

Bad looks like

? The part needs rework to fit, has missing or wrong mounting points, or causes belt misalignment.

? Spacer dimensions are missing, wrong or only discoverable by measuring the model.

? Drawings are under-dimensioned, untoleranced or not manufacturable as drawn.

? CAD and PDF are out of step, or a revision is issued without updating both.

? Only PDFs are delivered, or native files are withheld or filed in the wrong place.

? The numbering convention or templates are ignored.

? Models are messy and cannot be revised without rebuilding.

Because these parts sit inside the OEM warranty position that protects Ramair's market, a part that does not

fit has real downstream cost at the dealer. Changes that affect fit are validated against a sample before

release.



Timeframes (indicative turnaround, to be confirmed)



These are starting points, measured from when the part number, brief and scan data are provided, and should

be set against Ramair's real cadence. The clock does not start until inputs are complete. Missing scan data,

samples or a part number pauses the timeframe.

Other expectations



? Ownership of work product: all designs, models, drawings, scan-derived geometry and source files are

Ramair's intellectual property. The engineer signs an IP assignment and confidentiality agreement,

delivers all native and source files into Ramair's repository, and retains no sole copies.

? Toolset: work is done in a mainstream CAD package that reads 3D scan data and exports Parasolid and

DXF cleanly (for example SolidWorks, Inventor, Solid Edge or Fusion). Ramair owns or standardises the

licensing and file formats so the work is portable and the role can scale or change hands without

recreating files. The design data must never be locked to one person's private licence or machine.

? Version control and filing: incremental versioning, matched CAD and PDF, a changelog, and consistent

filing to the RM numbering scheme in the Engineering Folder.

? Validation: work to a simple change-control process and support sample checks before a changed part

goes live.

? Communication: responsive asynchronous communication across time zones, clear acknowledgement

of briefs, and weekly visibility of work in progress and queue.

? Confidentiality: designs, customer information and the fitment and warranty sensitivities are treated as

commercially confidential.

? Capacity to scale: able to absorb a backlog over time, including re-mastering the existing range into

editable models, the fitting-manuals programme, and digitising newly acquired product lines.

title: Finance Process & Controls Analyst
description:
The Finance Process & Controls Analyst is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of financial transactions across the Company's business systems. This role serves as the "exception detective" for Finance, proactively identifying failed transactions, process breakdowns, integration issues, and billing discrepancies before they impact customers, vendors, financial reporting, or cash flow.



The candidate possesses exceptional analytical skills, relentless attention to detail, and a passion for investigating complex problems. Rather than simply processing transactions, this individual will continuously improve business processes, identify automation opportunities, and partner with Finance, Operations, IT, and ERP teams to build scalable, highly reliable financial processes.

OBSESSIVE ATTENTION TO DETAIL

Transaction Monitoring & Exception Management

Identify invoices, purchase orders, receipts, customer orders, vendor bills, inventory transactions, and journal entries that failed to process correctly.

Resolve discrepancies or coordinate resolution with the appropriate business teams.

Investigate purchase order mismatches.

Monitor receiving, vendor bill matching, and approval workflows.

Identify duplicate payments or processing errors.

Validate tax treatment and coding.





Required

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or related field.

5-10 years of experience in accounting, finance operations, ERP systems, business process improvement, or financial systems.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Exceptional organizational and documentation skills.

Outstanding attention to detail.

Ability to investigate complex issues independently.



NetSuite experience.

ERP implementation experience.

SQL knowledge.

Power BI.

Lean or Six Sigma exposure.

title: Commercial Property Valuer
description:
# Commercial Property Valuer (Offshore, Full-Time)

**Property Lions | Remote — Must work Australian Eastern Time hours**



## About Us

Property Lions is a Sydney-based commercial real estate group operating across buyer's agency, property management, and funds management. We specialise in value-add commercial and industrial acquisitions in the $5M–$25M range across Australia, using a rigorous, data-driven approach to deal analysis. We're growing our research and analysis capability and looking for an experienced valuer to support our acquisitions pipeline.



## The Role

We're looking for an experienced commercial property valuer to join our team full-time, supporting feasibility analysis and market research for live deals across Australian commercial and industrial submarkets. This is not a client-facing valuation role — it's an internal research and analysis position embedded in our deal team, feeding directly into acquisition decisions, cap rate assessment, and exit strategy.



You'll work closely with our founder and deal team, translating raw market data into clear, defensible numbers that inform real investment decisions.



## Key Responsibilities

- Prepare feasibility reports and financial models for prospective commercial and industrial acquisitions

- Conduct comparable sales and leasing research across target submarkets (industrial, commercial, retail)

- Analyse cap rate trends, rental growth, vacancy rates, and yield benchmarks by region

- Support due diligence on prospective deals, including lease abstraction and rent reconciliation

- Build and maintain market data trackers across multiple Australian states and submarkets

- Assist with valuation inputs for internal investment committee papers and investor reporting

- Research zoning, planning, and infrastructure factors relevant to site value and highest-and-best-use assessment

- Work directly with the founder to stress-test assumptions on live deals



## What We're Looking For

- Demonstrated experience in commercial property valuation (industrial, office, retail, or mixed commercial assets)

- Strong understanding of valuation methodology — direct comparison, capitalisation, and discounted cash flow approaches

- Experience preparing or contributing to feasibility studies and investment analysis

- Strong Excel/financial modelling skills

- Excellent written English — reports need to be client- and investor-ready

- Familiarity with Australian commercial property market conventions (an advantage, not mandatory)

- Self-directed, comfortable working with minimal daily supervision once ramped up



## Working Requirements

- **Full-time**, working Australian Eastern Time (AEST/AEDT) business hours

- **Reliable, high-speed home or office internet connection** — this role involves live data work and regular video calls, so connection stability is essential

- Own laptop/desktop capable of running standard office and modelling software

- Quiet home or office work environment suitable for video calls



## Why Join Us

- Work directly with a fast-growing Australian commercial property business

- Exposure to real, live acquisition deals from $5M to $25M+

- Long-term full-time role with room to grow into a broader analysis/research position as the business scales



## How to Apply

Please submit your CV along with a short summary of your commercial property valuation experience, including the types of assets you've valued and any feasibility or investment analysis work you've done. Include answers to the following questions:

1. Who did you support in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?

2. Who is the Treasurer of Australia?

3. What's your hobbies and interests?

title: Detail-Oriented Video Editor Needed — Fast-Paced, High Volume (Full-Time)
description:
About us: We're an established digital agency running two active YouTube channels focused on business automation and tutorial content, with a consistent, growing publishing schedule. This isn't a one-off gig or a project that might disappear next month — we're building a long-term team and looking for someone to grow with us as content volume scales. You'll have a direct line to the person reviewing your work, with clear, consistent expectations from day one.



We produce high-volume YouTube content (talking-head + tutorial style videos) for two channels, with output scaling up to multiple videos per day. We're looking for someone to join long-term, not gig-hop.



What matters most to us, in order:



- English fluency — you must be able to read, understand, and catch spoken English clearly enough to spot every clipped word, mispronunciation, or awkward cut. This is non-negotiable.

- Zero tolerance for errors — no clipped words, no missing syllables, correct spelling and grammar on every caption/title/graphic, every single time.

- The video must make sense — if a cut breaks the logic or flow of what's being said, it's wrong, even if it's technically clean.

- Speed that can keep up with volume — we move fast. You'll need to turn around videos on a tight, recurring schedule without quality dropping.





Software: We currently use Descript. Experience with Descript is a plus, but NOT required — if you're highly skilled in Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut and can hit our quality bar, we will consider you, and can train you on Descript.



What you'll be doing:



- Editing talking-head and tutorial-style YouTube videos from raw footage/transcript

- Removing filler words, dead air, and mistakes while preserving natural flow

- Adding simple hook-style openers (we'll give you direction — this is not complex motion graphics)

- Basic captions, text overlays, and b-roll placement

- Careful, full-video proofreading before delivery — spelling, grammar, and continuity





What you will NOT be doing:

- Thumbnail design (handled separately)

- Uploading/publishing (unless later expanded)



Hard skills required:



- Strong English reading/listening comprehension (able to catch clipped words, mispronunciations, and awkward phrasing by ear)

- Video editing proficiency (Descript preferred; Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut also considered)

- Caption/text overlay accuracy — zero spelling or grammar errors

- Basic understanding of pacing and narrative flow in tutorial/talking-head content





Soft skills required:



- Deadline-driven — can consistently hit a recurring turnaround schedule under volume

- Self-starter — doesn't need hand-holding once given direction

- Coachable — takes feedback and redo requests without defensiveness

- Resilient under a fast-paced, high-volume workload

- Reliable and communicative — flags issues early instead of guessing





Who this is NOT for:



- Anyone who edits fast but skips a full watch-through before delivery

- Anyone uncomfortable being told "this isn't good enough yet, redo it"

- Anyone who can't commit to full-time, consistent hours





Who this IS for:



- Someone who catches the tiny stuff — a dropped word, a wrong "their/there," a jump cut that breaks the sentence

- Someone who wants a long-term full-time role, not a one-off gig

- Someone who takes pride in "this is clean" over "this is done"





We review every single video before it goes out. If it's not right, it comes back to you. We'd rather you take a bit longer and get it right than rush and miss something.



To apply:

Please put "AHOY [Your Name]" in the subject line of your application, in all caps. Applications without this will not be reviewed — this is our first filter for people who actually read job postings carefully (which, if you're detail-oriented, you will).



In the body of your application, please highlight or bold this section and answer it directly:





In 2-3 sentences, describe a time you caught a mistake in a video that someone else would have missed. What was it, and how did you catch it?





Also include:



- Your available start date

- Your typical weekly availability (hours/days)

- Links to 2-3 video editing samples (raw-to-final if possible)

- Your English proficiency level (spoken and written)

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER - Finance, Systems & Scale
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER



The Nordstick (HepPros LLC) | Remote | Full-Time



ABOUT THE NORDSTICK

The Nordstick is a fast-growing DTC fitness equipment brand built around premium functional products like the NordBench Pro. We have grown 400%+ year over year and are scaling aggressively. Our operation runs on Shopify with a pre-sale model, a manufacturing partner in Hong Kong, and a 3PL network across multiple U.S. warehouse locations.

Operations at The Nordstick is not admin work. It is cash flow management, inventory intelligence, execution speed, and margin protection.

We are looking for an elite Operations Manager who can think like a CFO, execute like an operator, and build systems that scale.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND IS NOT)



This role is not:

--> Updating spreadsheets without context

--> Reacting to problems after they happen

--> Overbuying inventory "just in case"

--> Managing ops without understanding cash flow



This role is:

--> Owning the 13-week cash flow forecast

--> Making inventory decisions tied to demand and capital

--> Using Shopify, data, and AI to stay ahead of issues

--> Coordinating across multiple 3PLs for speed and margin

--> Turning CX signals into product and process improvements

--> Being the connective tissue between our manufacturer in Hong Kong, our 3PL partners, our CS team, and leadership



WHO YOU ARE

You are not just operationally great. You understand money. You know what cash on hand means, why contribution margin matters, and how inventory decisions ripple into the P&L. You have built financial models before, not just maintained them, and you can walk a founder through a cash flow forecast without needing a finance team behind you.



You think in systems. You do not chase fires. You build the infrastructure that prevents them. When something breaks, you fix the root cause, not the symptom.



You are comfortable with AI tools, not just as a user but as a builder. You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to ship actual working systems, and you can maintain and improve what already exists.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



CASH FLOW AND FINANCIAL PLANNING

--> Build and own a rolling 13-week cash flow model, updated weekly, covering in-stock and pre-sale scenarios

--> Forecast inventory buys, marketing spend impact, loan repayments, and shipping and fulfillment costs

--> Model best-, base-, and worst-case scenarios

--> Model inventory financing decisions: Shopify Capital, working capital loans, supplier payment terms, and loan vs. payback rate tradeoffs

--> Know cash on hand, weekly burn, weekly contribution margin, and profitability to one decimal at all times

--> Ensure The Nordstick stays in stock without overbuying or locking up cash



INVENTORY AND DEMAND FORECASTING

--> Forecast demand using Shopify sales data, growth rates, seasonality, and marketing plans

--> D
 when and how much to reorder to prevent stockouts that kill 
ntum and overstock that traps capital

--> Manage POs from factory confirmation through container receipt, including ETD/ETA tracking and customs clearance via our freight forwarder

--> Track batch-level inventory counts and maintain the allocation sheet as the source of truth for CS order messaging

--> Monitor warehouse storage costs and manage dead inventory decisions in coordination with leadership

WORKING CAPITAL AND GROWTH FINANCING

--> Leverage Shopify Capital, working capital loans, and supplier terms strategically

--> Provide units-on-hand and container count data for leadership's negotiations with the manufacturing partner

--> Participate in tariff strategy decisions with the customs broker, including PSC filings and Section 232 duty refund coordination

--> Balance growth speed with financial safety; capital is used strategically, not emotionally



SHOPIFY AND SYSTEMS OWNERSHIP

--> Be deeply fluent in Shopify Admin: order-level actions, SKU management, fulfillment status, and operational data

--> Own operational data: orders, refunds, shipping costs, and inventory

--> Build and maintain dashboards, Google Sheets models, and custom reports

--> Bonus: ability to build custom dashboards or internal tools using Python, SQL, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script



3PL AND SHIPPING OPTIMIZATION

--> Manage our 3PL relationships across multiple U.S. warehouse locations using ShipHero and ShipStation

--> Maintain FIFO allocation rules across warehouses, manage priority-adjusted orders, and approve or deny partial shipments based on fulfillment logic

--> Manage the warehouse-level approval process for inbound POs, including specifying which SKUs go to which warehouse location based on velocity and buffer strategy

--> Track average shipping cost per unit weekly, by zone, and blended; reduce average shipping zones over time

--> Evaluate per-unit carrier cost tradeoffs for bulk freight and individual shipments

--> Maintain and update landed cost per unit as COGS, freight, and tariff conditions change

--> Escalate and track fulfillment errors through to resolution



CX TO OPS TO PRODUCT FEEDBACK LOOP

--> Work closely with Customer Support to identify repeat product issues, confusion points, and return drivers

--> Maintain the product issue and parts request tracker, categorized by defect type: product defect, instruction failure, info/expectation failure, and missing parts

--> Track issue counts weekly and trend over time to surface whether product changes are reducing complaints

--> Fix problems at the source by recommending improvements to instructional videos, setup guides, and product design

--> Serve as the primary source of truth for CS on shipping timelines by product and order date range



AI AND EFFICIENCY LEVERAGE

--> Work hands-on with agentic AI tools, specifically Claude Code, to build, maintain, and improve internal operational systems

--> Build and maintain existing dashboards and reporting tools; this is not a "use AI to summarize" role, it requires actual implementation work

--> Automate reporting, flag anomalies, and reduce manual work across the ops function

--> Identify new automation opportunities and scope them into working tools, not just proposals

--> Follow the principle: AI handles repetition, humans make decisions



WEEKLY REPORTING

--> Produce a Weekly Ops State of the Union for the CEO covering: North Star KPI movement, inventory health, fulfillment dates, shipping zone breakdown, product issue counts, and 13-week cash runway

--> Coordinate with marketing on customer lists tied to batch ship dates for
 sends

--> Work with finance on PO creation, payment coordination, and Shopify/ShipHero cleanup ahead of incoming shipments



TOOLS YOU WILL USE DAILY

--> Shopify Admin: order-level actions, SKU management, and fulfillment status

--> ShipHero: warehouse inventory management, FIFO allocation, PO tracking, and partial shipment logic

--> ShipStation: individual order shipment management

--> Google Sheets: 13-week cash flow model, ops dashboard, allocation sheet, reshipment tracker, and shipment timeline tracker

--> Slack: cross-functional coordination with CS, marketing, finance, and leadership

--> Asana: task tracking and project management

--> Richpanel: visibility into CS ticket data related to ops issues

--> Freight forwarder portal: freight tracking and customs documentation

--> Triple Whale: awareness of how ops data (COGS, shipping cost) affects profit reporting



NORTH STAR KPIs

You will be evaluated monthly on three metrics:

--> Average Shipping Cost per Unit: direction: down month over month

--> Average Time to Ship to Customer: direction: down month over month

--> Product Reliability Index (product-related issues per 100 orders): direction: down month over month

If two or more are improving, Ops is winning. If one or fewer are improving, we are not. No debate. No overrides.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves:

--> Proven experience in DTC or e-commerce operations, ideally with pre-sale or made-to-order inventory models

--> Strong financial literacy: cash flow forecasting, margin analysis, working capital management

--> Advanced Google Sheets skills; ability to build and maintain financial models with real data

--> Shopify fluency: operations, not just navigation

--> Experience managing inventory and fulfillment across multiple 3PLs

--> Hands-on experience with agentic AI tools, specifically Claude Code; you must be able to build with it, not just prompt it

--> Ability to build and maintain internal dashboards and operational reporting tools

--> Systems thinker: you prevent problems, not chase them

--> Strong communicator who proactively loops in CS, marketing, and leadership without being asked

Strong Bonus Points:

--> Built cash flow dashboards and models before; must be able to show samples

--> Experience scaling fast-growing DTC brands

--> AI-assisted coding experience (Python, SQL, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script using tools like Claude Code or Cursor)

--> Experience working with freight forwarders and customs brokers

--> Familiarity with ShipHero or a comparable WMS



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

--> In-stock rate without cash strain

--> Clean, accurate cash flow visibility at all times

--> Lower shipping cost per order month over month

--> Fewer CX issues caused by ops failures

--> Faster decisions with less chaos



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to 

--> Your resume

--> An intro video, under 5 minutes, where you introduce yourself and answer why you believe you are a good fit for this role

--> A link or sample of a cash flow model or financial dashboard you have built and maintained before

--> A Loom or Zoom recording walking us through that sample work



Applications without the sample work and video will not be reviewed.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER (GHL SPECIALIST)

Go Ignite  |  Fully Remote  |  Monday-Friday  |  7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

PHP 80,000/month + OTE  |  Prepaid HMO  |  Paid Time Off



If you can build a full GHL white label environment from scratch, run paid ads that convert, and own results end-to-end -- read on. 



If you have never led a team, need hand-holding, prefer to execute someone else's strategy, or are not ready to commit to a full 8-hour day with an international team -- this role is not for you.



Go Ignite is hiring one person for this role. We are not filling a seat. We are building our internal digital engine, and we need someone who has done this before at a high level.



This role is NOT for you if:

You have only used GHL as an end-user - proven sub-account builds, white label setups, and A2P/10DLC experience are required

You have never managed paid campaigns for Australian or US-based clients

You cannot show us real outcomes: funnels you built, ads you ran, metrics that moved

You are looking for someone to tell you what to do every day

You have never led, coordinated, or managed a marketing team or direct reports

 

About Go Ignite

Go Ignite is the growth and technology division of a specialist international recruitment group connecting top Filipino talent with high-growth Australian and US businesses. We build the systems -- the funnels, automations, and campaigns - that power candidate attraction and client conversion at scale. This is an internal hire. You will own the tools that drive the business.



The Role

You will lead the Go Ignite marketing function. The marketing team reports directly to you, giving leadership full visibility without day-to-day involvement. You own the GHL ecosystem, drive paid campaign performance, and set the standard for how the team executes and grows. This is a player-coach role -- you build, you lead, and you are accountable for results.



These are the five areas you will own:



Team Leadership & Direction

Lead and coordinate the Go Ignite marketing team -- you are the go-to for direction, prioritisation, and performance

Set weekly priorities, run team check-ins, and ensure campaigns and systems are moving without requiring escalation to the owner

Build and maintain SOPs so the team operates to a consistent standard and scales without bottlenecks

Report to the business owner on team performance, key wins, and strategic recommendations.



GHL Systems & Automation

Full white label environment management: sub-account setup, affiliate manager configuration, A2P/10DLC registration and compliance

Build and maintain lead generation funnels, automation workflows, nurture sequences, appointment booking flows, and CRM pipelines from scratch

Provide technical support and troubleshoot across workflows, deliverability, domains, and third-party integrations

Develop SOPs and documentation so systems scale without you as a single point of failure.



Paid Advertising

Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta 
/Instagram), Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube -- ad creatives and copy are supplied by the team

A/B test audiences, landing pages, and ad sets using performance data and AI-driven insights

Manage CPL, ROAS, and conversion targets across Australian and US market campaigns



Web, Integrations & Landing Pages

Maintain WordPress sites: forms, tracking pixels, domain configuration, webhooks, Zapier integrations

Build high-converting landing pages that support campaign objectives



Analytics, Reporting & Social

Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports across GHL dashboards, Google Analytics, and ad platforms

Support social media content scheduling and brand presence using AI tools and content calendars

Recommend improvements across funnels, paid ads, and
/SMS campaigns based on data. 



What You Must Bring

3+ years hands-on experience as a GHL Specialist or Digital Marketer -- not as a VA who uses GHL, but as someone who builds in it

Proven full white label GHL setup experience: sub-account creation, affiliate manager config, A2P/10DLC registration

Demonstrated paid ads results on Meta and/or Google Ads for Australian or US clients -- you have screenshots, ROAS data, or client outcomes to show us

WordPress integration skills: pixels, tracking, domains, webhooks, Zapier

Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, or similar) for content and automation tasks

Excellent written and spoken English -- you communicate directly with an international team daily

Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating a marketing team -- you know how to set direction, give feedback, and drive accountability

Self-directed, organised, and able to manage multiple campaigns and people without daily supervision

 

Why This Role Stands Apart



Most GHL roles in the Philippines are VA-level: follow the SOP, raise a ticket, wait for approval. This is not that.

You own the GHL ecosystem -- architecture decisions are yours

You work directly with the leadership team, not through layers of management

You see the full picture: how funnels feed ads, how ads feed the pipeline, how the pipeline drives revenue

You lead the marketing team -- this is a genuine step into a Head of Marketing function

International exposure with Australian and US market campaigns -- resume-building work with real accountability 

Compensation & Benefits



PHP 80,000/month base + OTE

Base salary: PHP 80,000/month. On-target earnings (OTE) are payable on top of base, tied to agreed performance outcomes. Total compensation for a strong performer exceeds base.

Prepaid HMO (ask us about dependent coverage options)

Paid Time Off

Fully remote -- work from anywhere in the Philippines

Full-time, 40 hours/week | Monday-Friday | 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

Direct access to leadership and real career growth as the business scales



How to Apply

We review every application personally. We do not shortlist candidates who skip these steps.

1. Your updated CV

2. A 2-3 minute video introduction: who you are, why this role is the right next step, and a walkthrough of one GHL build you are proud of

3. Your portfolio -- funnels, automations, ad campaign results,
 sequences -- anything with measurable outcomes (Google Drive, Notion, or Loom links are fine).

4. A written answer to the screening question below, included in your application message

Screening Question (required):

Walk us through a GHL white label setup you have completed end-to-end. What did the configuration involve? How did you handle A2P/10DLC registration? What did the finished client environment look like, and what were the results for the client?



Applications without a written answer to this question will not be reviewed.

If your application is strong, you will hear from us within 3-5 business days.

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

We need someone to own our TikTok Shop affiliate program end to end. This is a remote, full-time position. You'll be the person finding creators, reviewing their profiles, reaching out to them, managing samples, sourcing TikTok Live sellers, and making sure affiliates are actually posting and converting.



**What You'll Do**



- Search TikTok Shop's creator marketplace and find affiliates who fit our brand (streetwear, sneaker culture, lifestyle, men's fashion)

- Review creator profiles using Cruva — check GMV history, video performance, follower quality, and brand fit before approving sample requests

- Send outreach messages to qualified creators and follow up with affiliates who ghosted after receiving samples

- Source and recruit creators specifically for TikTok Live selling — we generate strong revenue from livestreams and need people who can actually sell on camera

- Stay on top of TikTok trends and proactively suggest video formats, hooks, and content angles that will work for our product

- Track affiliate performance weekly and escalate top performers for paid partnerships or higher commissions

- Manage the full sample request queue — approve, reject, or message creators based on their profile



**What We're Looking For**



- Hands-on experience with Cruva (required — this is our primary tool for managing affiliates)

- Experience with TikTok Shop seller tools (creator marketplace, sample requests, Seller Center)

- Strong eye for content — you should be able to watch a creator's recent videos and quickly assess whether they can move product

- Experience sourcing or managing TikTok Live sellers is a strong plus

- Solid English writing for creator outreach and follow-ups

- Self-directed and organized — you'll be managing a daily queue without someone micromanaging you

- Bonus: familiar with Claude AI or other AI tools for outreach and research



**Compensation**



- Fixed monthly rate (discussed based on experience)

- Performance bonus tied to affiliate GMV



**Hours**



Full-time



---



**To Apply — Complete Both Tasks First**



Applications without these will not be reviewed.



---



**Task 1: Diagnose These Affiliates**



Below are three real affiliates from our TikTok Shop. Tell us what you see and exactly what you would do.

- 520,000 followers

- Average video views: 42,385

- Videos posted for us: 2

- Total brand GMV generated: $8,430

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $4,835

- Status: Has not posted in a long time



**Affiliate 

- 18,000 followers (fast growing)

- Videos posted for us: 44 | Lives: 3

- Total brand GMV: $15,599

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $54,530

- Content quality score: 91/100

- Status: Requested a new sample over a month ago. Never posted after receiving it.



**Affiliate 

- 36,000 followers (fast growing)

- Videos posted for us: 158

- Total brand GMV: $7,543 (~$47 per video)

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $84,830

- Content quality score: 95/100

- Average video views: 735

- Status: Posts consistently but barely converts

2. What would you do next? Be specific — not "follow up," but what you'd actually do and why.

3. Write the exact message you'd send them right now.



---



**Task 2: Find Us 5 Affiliates**

1. Their TikTok handle

2. Follower count and average views

3. One sentence on why you think they're a fit



---



Paste everything directly in your application. No cover letter needed. Just these two tasks.

title: Operations & Tech Assistant (Make.com / GHL / AI Automation / n8n)
description:
APPLY HERE: 



About Us

PulseLink is a fast-growing UK-based marketing agency helping aesthetic clinics (medical spas, body sculpting clinics, facial aesthetic clinics) scale profitably using paid ads, AI-powered appointment setting, and a done-for-you service model.



We're currently working with 13 active clients across the UK and we're about to break into the US market — which is the entire reason this role exists.



This is not a job at a 100-person agency where you'll be one cog in a machine. We're small, hungry, and building this thing properly. The right hire here gets to build the foundation of a much bigger operation alongside the founder.



About the Role

We're hiring an Operations & Tech Assistant to own the technical backend of the business.



Right now, the founder (Oli) is spending 80% of his time on backend ops — building automations, configuring GoHighLevel sub-accounts for new clients, fixing tech that breaks, migrating workflows onto a new platform stack. That's the bottleneck stopping us from signing more clients and breaking into the US.



Your job is to take all of that off his plate — and become the person responsible for keeping the entire backend running smoothly as we scale.



You'd be the first dedicated person in this seat at PulseLink, which means:



Real ownership over the tech stack and how it's built

Your fingerprints on the SOPs the next 10–20 hires follow

Direct line to the founder — no middle management

Pay and responsibility grow with you as we scale



Key Responsibilities

Client Onboarding — Set up new clients in GoHighLevel: configure sub-accounts, pipelines, calendars, forms, welcome automations. Target: every new client launched within 7 days.


 Automation Migration — We're currently moving the entire business onto a new automation stack. You will own this migration end-to-end.

AI Texting Agent Management — We use AI to text leads on behalf of every client. You'll train it, debug it, and optimise it so it works for every clinic as we scale.

Daily Tech Tickets — Fix integrations, calendar syncs, pixel issues, broken automations. When something breaks at 8am, you're the person who diagnoses and fixes it.

SOP Creation — Build documentation for every recurring process so the next hire can follow it without asking questions.

R&D / Process Improvement — Bring 2+ ideas per month on how we can run faster, leaner, or smarter. We don't want a task-completer — we want a builder.

Client Communication — Talk to clinic owners on Slack and occasionally Zoom about tech-related questions. Clear, professional English is non-negotiable here.



Skills & Tools Required

Strong experience with 
 (formerly Integromat) — you've built multi-step automations before, not just turned on templates

Solid working knowledge of GoHighLevel — sub-accounts, pipelines, workflows, custom fields, integrations

Experience with AI tools in a professional context — bonus if you've used Claude Code or Cursor for building/editing scripts

Familiarity with AI conversational agents (chat bots, AI SMS responders) — building, training, or maintaining

Fluency with Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, trackers)

Excellent written English — you'll be talking to UK clinic owners

Ability to manage 10+ open tickets without dropping the ball

Resourcefulness — you Google before you ask, you bring solutions not problems, and you'd rather ask for forgiveness than permission



Nice-to-have (not required)

Beauty / aesthetics industry experience (we'll train you)

Past experience at a marketing agency

Notion / ClickUp for ops management

Meta 
) Ads Manager familiarity for troubleshooting pixel issues



What We Offer

$700–$900/month base depending on experience, paid weekly via Wise/PayPal

Monthly performance bonuses — client retention bonus, SOP compliance bonus, R&D bonus

Pay scales as the company grows and as you take on more responsibility

100% remote, work from anywhere in the GMT-friendly timezone

Direct mentorship from the founder

Real ownership over your domain — no micromanagement, just outcomes



Do NOT Apply If…

You dislike high-pressure environments

You struggle to adapt quickly to change

You're uncomfortable receiving direct feedback

You need to be told what to do every step — common sense and ownership are non-negotiable

You're looking for a "chill remote job" — this isn't one

You don't speak/write fluent English



How to Apply

APPLY HERE: 



Important — applications without a Loom video are automatically declined. No exceptions. The application asks you to record a short Loom video introducing yourself and walking through one tech system or automation you've built. If you skip this step, you will not be considered.

title: Medical Billing Specialist — Full Revenue Cycle (Remote)
description:
Medical Billing Specialist — Full Revenue Cycle (Remote)



Company: BIAF — a growing clinical operation (chiropractic / personal injury and beyond)



Type: Part-time - Full Time (Based on performance), remote US Hours 10:30a EST start time 



Compensation: $7–$8/hour base + opportunity for growth



About the role



We're looking for a well-rounded, full revenue-cycle medical biller — someone with diverse billing experience across multiple insurance types and specialties, who doesn't just submit claims but chases the money. You'll own cases from charge posting through collection. Personal injury / PIP is an important part of our work, so PI experience matters — but we want a biller with range: commercial, Medicare, credentialing, and multi-payer experience, who can handle whatever comes across the desk and grow with us as the operation expands.



We have documented SOPs, so a strong biller onboards fast.



What you'll do



Post charges and EOBs; keep case records current and accurate



Work medical systems including ChiroTouch, Availity, and our proprietary tools



Manage clinical process: authorizations, confirmations, medical record retrieval, patient verification, appointments, and follow-ups



Own claims end-to-end across payer types — submit, track, follow up, collect



Chase A/R relentlessly (this is the core of the job — you don't submit and forget)



Handle personal injury / PIP / LOP / lien cases and standard commercial / Medicare billing



Communicate directly with attorneys, adjusters, insurers, and payers by phone and
 (US-facing)



Verify eligibility and coverage; work payer portals



Hard requirements



Strong written and spoken English — you'll be on US phones and
 with attorneys, adjusters, insurers, and patients. Non-negotiable.

Diverse medical billing experience — you've billed across multiple insurance types (commercial, Medicare, and ideally PI/PIP), not just one narrow lane

A/R follow-up and collections experience — you chase, you don't just submit

Solid command of billing terminology — you know the terms cold and can pick up a new system quickly

Availity / payer-portal experience



Strongly preferred (weighted heavily)



Personal injury / PIP / auto-a
 billing — an important part of our caseload; real PI experience moves you up

Insurance credentialing (provider enrollment, payer credentialing)

Medicare billing depth

Commercial insurance billing across multiple payers

Multi-specialty experience — the versatile biller who scales with us



Bonus



Experience with ChiroTouch (our current system) — a plus, but if you know the terminology and billing fundamentals, you'll pick it up fast. We care more that you're a strong, versatile biller than that you've used our exact software.



Not a fit if



You only do medical coding (you code, but don't chase money)

You're a narrow single-payer or single-specialty biller with no range

You do data-entry claims submission only (submit-and-forget)



To apply — answer these (applications without answers won't be reviewed)



What types of insurance and specialties have you billed for? Walk us through your range.

Describe a case you personally drove from unpaid to collected. What was stuck, and what did you do?

What's the difference between how you'd handle a PIP claim vs. a LOP/lien case vs. a standard commercial claim?

Do you have credentialing or Medicare experience? Describe it.

Rate your spoken English 1–10 and tell us where you've used it on the phone with US parties.



Screening process: short paid trial with sanitized sample files (including edge cases across payer types) + a brief video call to assess spoken English. Strong performers move to a supervised Week 1.
