title: Meta Ads Video Editor for Direct Response (E-Commerce) - AI Video Editor - Performance Bonus
description:
We are a fast-growing eCommerce brand that produces high-volume Meta ads and is seeking an exceptionally skilled Paid Social Creative Editor who can produce AI-enhanced video ads and static creatives at scale. This role is for someone who understands direct-response marketing, fast-paced iteration, and AI generation workflows, not basic aesthetic editing. What you will do: 



-Create high-volume paid social videos (UGC-style, product demos, problem–solution, voiceover visuals, testimonial edits). 

-Generate AI-powered visuals using tools like: 

Google VEO 3 

Higgsfield 

Google Gemini 

AI UGC avatar tools 

AI image generators 

-Build static ads using a mix of AI visuals + our existing asset library. 

-Receive a creative brief (concept, angle, script) and independently produce: 

3–10 video variations 

5–20 static image variations 

-Rapid iterations based on feedback and performance data 

-Add engaging on-screen text, captions, VFX, and sound design. 

-Incorporate our pre-existing footage + newly generated AI elements. 

-Help conceptualize ideas that improve CTR, hook rate, thumbstop ratio, and ROAS. 

-Deliver creatives in a Meta-native format (short form, mobile-first, bold text, fast pacing). 



Required Skills + Experience (please do not apply if you don't meet the criteria):



Direct-Response Creative Editing 

-Knowledge of high-performing Meta ads formats 

-Strong understanding of: Hooks, Pacing, Retention strategy, CTA placement AI Video & Image Generation (Advanced) 

-Strong prompting abilities 

Ability to generate:, AI actors/UGC avatars, AI B-roll, AI product shots *

-Workflow experience (storyboarding, prompt crafting, refining, upscaling) 

-Technical Editing Software Skills 

Adobe Premiere Pro 

CapCut

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro 

Photoshop, Canva, or Figma for static ads 

Ability to sync voiceovers and maintain pacing 



Paid Social Creative Knowledge 

-Understanding of creative testing 

-Ability to interpret creative performance metrics like: Hook rate, Thumbstop percentage, CTR, Watch-time dropoff 



Work Speed 

-MUST be able to produce high-volume output daily 

-Must be able to turn around creative requests within 24–48 hours 



English Proficiency 

-Must be able to communicate verbally and over text proficiently in English



How to Apply

To prove you actually read this (most applicants don't), please do the following:



1. Start your application with the word "Lion" — applications without this will be ignored.

2. Send 3–5 examples of Meta ads you personally edited (Drive, YouTube, or Meta Ads Library links). - the more examples the better

3. Tell me in 2–3 sentences: what makes a Meta ad hook work in the first 3 seconds?

4. Your turnaround time for 3 creatives

5. What type of products or brands you’ve worked with before

6. Share your monthly rate and your main editing software.

7. Bonus: link to one e-commerce brand whose Meta ads you admire — and why.

title: Senior Sales Advisor – Online Beauty Education
description:
About Bela Beauty College:

We're one of Australia's leading online beauty education providers — with 20,000+ students trained and a fast-growing course suite spanning beauty, aesthetics, and professional development.

We run a high-performance phone sales model and we're looking for a Senior Sales Advisor who genuinely loves selling, knows how to build trust fast, and can convert warm inbound leads into enrolled students — consistently.

This is not a cold calling role. Leads come to us.



What You'll Be Doing:

Calling warm inbound leads who have already expressed interest in our courses

Running discovery conversations to understand what the student needs and matching them to the right program

Following up with leads who haven't yet committed — via phone and

Hitting monthly enrolment targets and KPIs

Keeping CRM records clean and up to date after every call

Collaborating with the team to refine scripts and objection handling





Who We're Looking For:

You're not just a phone rep — you're a closer. You know how to listen, build rapport fast, and guide someone to a confident yes.



You have:

3+ years in phone-based sales (education, B2C, or high-ticket preferred)

A strong track record of hitting or exceeding targets

Excellent spoken and written English — clear, warm, and professional

Experience using a CRM (we use a cloud-based system — training provided)

The ability to handle objections without being pushy

A reliable internet connection and quiet workspace



Bonus points if you've sold in the education or online course space before.



What We Offer:

Competitive base salary + performance incentives

Full-time, stable remote role with a growing Australian business

Supportive team culture — we invest in our people

Clear KPIs and uncapped incentive potential

Ongoing training, scripts, and sales resources provided





To Apply:

Send us your CV and a short voice recording (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and telling us why you're great at sales. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Executive Assistant & Business Operations Coordinator
description:
Hours: 20–25 hours per week initially (with opportunity to grow)



About Us



We're a small but ambitious Australian business building a portfolio of companies across media, technology and digital services. We believe in working smarter through systems, automation and AI, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us as we launch new ventures over the coming years.



Our current businesses include:



- A drone photography, videography and marketing service for the civil construction and land development industry.

- A newly launching website product, purpose-built for subdivision and land developers, offering fast-turnaround, per-project landing pages and websites.

- Additional ventures currently in development.



About the Role



We're looking for an organised, detail-oriented and proactive Executive Assistant to become an integral part of our team as we build and grow our portfolio of businesses.



Your first and most important focus will be helping get our new website product off the ground - from setting up the systems and processes behind it, to supporting outreach to our first clients. Once that's running smoothly, you'll also help support our established photography and videography business, before growing into a broader operations role across the wider portfolio as new ventures launch.



This isn't a traditional Executive Assistant role. You'll work closely with our directors across multiple businesses, helping turn ideas into reality, keeping projects moving, improving systems, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.



No two weeks will look the same. In the early stages, you'll be focused on building out the intake process, client pipeline and admin systems for our newest business. From there, you might be managing inboxes, coordinating calendars and organising travel - or helping launch a new website, improving a business process, researching AI tools, coordinating freelancers or assisting with the development of a new venture.



If you enjoy working with startups, solving problems, improving systems and wearing multiple hats, we'd love to hear from you.



What You'll Be Doing



Getting Our New Website Product Off the Ground (Priority Focus)



- Helping set up and refine our client intake and enquiry process from first contact through to project handover.

- Supporting the build-out of our CRM pipeline, templates and automated workflows for this business.

- Documenting a repeatable, end-to-end process for how projects are scoped, built, reviewed and delivered.

- Researching and building a list of target clients.

- Assisting with early outreach and follow-up once we're ready to start engaging prospects.

- Drafting simple marketing collateral (one-pagers, landing page copy) for review.



Executive Support



- Managing multiple inboxes and responding to
s where appropriate.

- Coordinating business and personal calendars.

- Scheduling meetings and appointments.

- Following up outstanding actions and keeping priorities organised.

- Organising travel, bookings and administrative tasks.

- Providing day-to-day executive support to the directors.



Business Operations



- Assisting with the launch of new products and services.

- Coordinating projects across multiple businesses.

- Managing task boards and ensuring projects stay on track.

- Creating, documenting and improving business systems and processes.

- Researching software, suppliers and business opportunities.

- Preparing documents, proposals and presentations.

- Assisting with the recruitment, onboarding and coordination of contractors and freelancers, including website designers, graphic designers, photo and video editors, and other specialist roles as our businesses grow.

- Liaising with contractors to ensure projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.

- Assisting with general business administration.



Innovation & Automation



We're always looking for smarter ways to work. You'll play an active role in helping us leverage technology, AI and automation to improve productivity and streamline our businesses.



This may include:



- Identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated.

- Researching, testing and implementing new AI tools and software.

- Creating and documenting workflows and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Assisting with the implementation of CRM, automation and business management systems.

- Building simple automations using no-code platforms and AI tools (training can be provided).

- Using AI tools to assist with research, drafting content, meeting notes and day-to-day administration.

- Continually identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through better systems and technology.



Marketing & Content Support



- Assisting with website updates.

- Scheduling social media content.

- Uploading blogs and marketing material.

- Coordinating content creation projects.

- Assisting with general marketing activities across our businesses.



General Support



- Responding to customer enquiries.

- CRM management.

- Data entry and reporting.

- Assisting wherever required to help keep the businesses running efficiently.



About You



We're looking for someone who:



- Takes initiative without waiting to be asked.

- Has exceptional attention to detail.

- Loves organising people, projects and systems.

- Is naturally curious and enjoys learning new skills.

- Communicates professionally in written and spoken English.

- Can confidently manage multiple priorities.

- Enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where every week is different.

- Thinks ahead and solves problems before they arise.

- Is comfortable working independently while collaborating with a growing team.

- Embraces technology and enjoys finding smarter ways to work.

- Is comfortable being one of the first people to help stand up a brand-new business from the ground up, not just support an established one.



Experience with tools such as Google Workspace, Notion, Dubsado, Trello, Canva, Loom, ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI and productivity tools will be highly regarded.



What We're Looking For



This role is more about mindset than experience.



We're looking for someone who is proactive, curious and genuinely enjoys making businesses run better. You'll take ownership of your work, look for opportunities to improve systems, and enjoy solving problems without waiting to be told what to do.



In return, you'll be trusted with significant responsibility from day one and have the opportunity to grow alongside our businesses as they expand. As the role evolves, you'll have the chance to take on greater responsibility and help shape how our businesses operate.



What Success Looks Like



After the first 90 days, success means:



- Our newest business has a documented, repeatable client process running end-to-end, with at least one project delivered through it.

- You're confidently running that business's day-to-day admin and enquiries with minimal oversight.

- You've started supporting our established photography and videography business alongside it.



After six months in the role, success means:



- Our inboxes, calendars and day-to-day administration are running smoothly with minimal oversight.

- Projects are organised, progressing efficiently and nothing is slipping through the cracks.

- Business systems and processes have been documented, improved and, where possible, automated.

- AI tools and automations have been introduced to eliminate repetitive work and improve efficiency.

- Contractors and freelancers are being sourced, onboarded and coordinated effectively, allowing projects to move forward without unnecessary delays.

- You're confidently managing priorities across multiple businesses while adapting to new ventures as they're launched.

- You're proactively identifying problems, presenting solutions and taking ownership rather than waiting for direction.

- Our directors are spending less time on administration and more time focused on strategy, growth and building the business.

- You've become a trusted right hand to the directors and an integral part of our team.



Hours & Growth



- Starting at 20–25 hours per week.

- We're an Australian business and generally operate between 7:00am and 6:00pm AEST. While your hours can be flexible, we'd prefer someone who can overlap with our team during Australian business hours to support collaboration.

- This role has genuine opportunity to increase in hours as our businesses grow.

- There is potential for the role to develop into a full-time Business Operations or Operations Manager position over time.



To Apply



Please include:



- A brief introduction about yourself.

- Your relevant experience.

- Why this role interests you.

- Your availability.

- Your hourly rate.

- The software, AI and productivity tools you've used.

- A short example of a time you improved a process or solved a problem without being asked.



To strengthen your application, we'd love you to include a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself, telling us why you're interested in the role, and why you'd be a great fit.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a genuine part of our team - not just fill a position. If you're excited by the opportunity to help build multiple businesses from the ground up while growing your own skills and career, we'd love to hear from you.

We are looking for someone with hands-on experience managing international trademark portfolios. This is not a role for someone who has only assisted lawyers or is willing to learn trademarks. We need someone who can independently manage trademark searches, filings, renewals, portfolio maintenance, deadline tracking and IP administration across multiple jurisdictions while supporting our Regulatory Lead with cosmetic regulatory work. 



Key Responsibilities 



1. Trademark & Intellectual Property (Primary Responsibility) 



Independently manage UAS Pharmaceuticals' global trademark portfolio. 



Conduct trademark clearance searches and assess trademark availability. 



Prepare and file trademark applications where direct filing is permitted. 



Manage trademark renewals, office actions, deadlines and opposition periods. 



Maintain an accurate trademark database by brand, country, Nice Class, filing date, renewal date and status. 



Coordinate with IP lawyers only when specialist legal advice is required. 



Review trademark classifications and filing strategies. 



Monitor competitor filings and potential conflicts. 



Prepare supporting documents for assignments, declarations, renewals and evidence of use. 



Recommend cost-effective filing strategies across jurisdictions. 



Ensure no trademark deadlines are missed. 



Continuously improve internal trademark systems and processes. 



2. Regulatory Affairs (Supporting Responsibility) 



Support the Regulatory Lead with cosmetic product registrations and notifications. 



Prepare product dossiers, technical files, SDS, GMP Certificates, COA, CFS, Halal documents and related regulatory documentation. 



Review product labels, artwork and marketing claims for compliance. 



Support registrations across ASEAN, Australia, New Zealand, Middle East, Europe and other export markets. 



Monitor cosmetic regulations and maintain regulatory trackers. 



Coordinate with distributors, authorities and internal teams. 



Requirements 



Mandatory Trademark Experience 



Minimum 5 years of proven Trademark/IP experience. 



Hands-on experience with trademark searches, applications, renewals, office actions and portfolio management. 



Strong understanding of Nice Classification. 



Experience managing international trademark portfolios (Highly Preferred). 



Experience working with WIPO, Madrid Protocol, USPTO, EUIPO, UKIPO, IP Australia or similar IP offices. 



Experience coordinating with external trademark attorneys. 



Regulatory Experience 



Experience in Cosmetics, Personal Care, Pharmaceutical, Nutraceutical or FMCG regulatory affairs. 



Experience with cosmetic product registrations, label reviews, claims compliance, ingredient compliance and regulatory documentation. 



ASEAN Cosmetic Directive experience is highly preferred. 



Skills 



Exceptional attention to detail 



Strong written English 



Highly organised and able to work independently 



Excellent spreadsheet and document management skills 



Strong research and analytical skills 



Commercially minded and cost-conscious 



What We're Looking For 



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our global trademark portfolio from Day One. The successful candidate should already understand international trademark systems and be capable of independently managing routine trademark matters. Regulatory Affairs experience is important, but Trademark & IP management is the primary responsibility of this role. 



IMPORTANT: Application Questions 



How many years of Trademark/IP experience do you have? 



Which countries have you personally handled trademark filings or renewals for? 



Have you managed an international trademark portfolio? Please describe. 



Which IP offices or trademark databases have you used? 



Have you worked with Madrid Protocol applications? 



What Regulatory Affairs experience do you have? 



Have you handled cosmetic registrations and compliance globally

title: SOCIAL MEDIA & E-COMMERCE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA & E-COMMERCE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT

Men's Health Brand | Part Time to Full Time | Remote | Long-term



IMPORTANT

This is a hands-on management and coordination role. We are looking for one capable person to run our day-to-day social media, Meta advertising, and Shopify operations — and keep it all working together. If you only do one of these things, this role is probably not for you. If you can do all of them and enjoy owning the whole picture, keep reading.

This is not a role for the faint-hearted. We are a winning culture. We work hard, we back each other, and we expect everyone on the team to pull their weight and take pride in the result.



ABOUT DAYFUEL

Dayfuel is an Australian men's health brand helping everyday men feel better every day. We're not a bodybuilding brand. We're not a biohacking brand.

Most Australian men know they should be looking after themselves. The problem is life gets busy. That's where Dayfuel comes in. Our products are designed to make good nutrition easier, not more complicated.

Our voice is simple, practical, relatable, and occasionally a little dry. We speak like real Australians and avoid fitness clichés, miracle claims and health guru nonsense.



THE TEAM

You won't be doing this alone. Dayfuel already has a Creative Director, a Content Creator and a Video Creator. Your job is to be the engine room — taking what the creative team produces and making sure it gets published, promoted and converted, so all our efforts and messaging are rewarded.

You'll work directly with the founder and be a genuine part of the team, not an outsourced afterthought.



THE ROLE

You will be the person who keeps Dayfuel's daily marketing engine running. That includes:

Social Media Management



Scheduling and publishing posts, Reels and Stories on Instagram and

Managing our content calendar and coordinating with the creative team

Replying to DMs and comments in brand voice, and escalating anything important to the founder

Outreach DMs and engagement on relevant pages, groups and communities



Meta Advertising



Managing campaigns in Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager

Monitoring ad performance, budgets and catalogue health

Weekly reporting on what's working and what's not — in plain English, not jargon



Shopify



Managing products, collections, pages and content updates

Monitoring the Meta–Shopify integration (pixel, catalogue, sales channel)

Flagging broken links, errors or anything that could cost us sales



Coordination



Bringing all of the above together so content, ads and the website tell one consistent story

Making sure nothing the creative team produces sits idle — everything gets used, everything works





WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



Proven experience running Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager (not just boosting posts)

Real Shopify experience — you know your way around the admin

Excellent written English — you will be speaking as the brand

Organised, reliable and proactive. You see problems before we do

A winner's mindset — you take ownership, you follow through, and you don't go missing

Experience with health, wellness or e-commerce brands is a strong plus



We care more about what you've actually done than your resume. Show us accounts you've managed, ads you've run, and results you've achieved.



HOURS & RATE

Part-time to start (approximately 20 hours per week) with a clear path to full-time as the brand grows. USD $6–$9 per hour depending on experience, reviewed as you prove yourself.

We're a small, easy-going team and we genuinely value good people. If you take pride in your work, want to win, and want to be part of something being built from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

Together we achieve more at Dayfuel.



TO APPLY

Start your application with the phrase "I run the engine." so we know you've read this ad properly. Then tell us:



Two brands or businesses whose social media and/or Meta ads you have managed, and what you achieved

Your Shopify experience in two or three sentences

The tools you use for scheduling, reporting and task management



Applications that don't follow this format will not be reviewed.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Assistant (Remote, Long-Term)

Skills to Change Institute  ·  Work from home  ·  Basic social media role  ·  Results-based hours



Who I am, and what this is

I'm Robert Gene. For thirty years, I've taught people how to update the memories that drive their behavior, so they stop suffering and start living. I'm hiring a social media person to get that work into the feeds people scroll when they're hurting.

This is a basic, hands-on role to start. Post consistently, keep the channels alive, and grow the audience. If you care about the mission and you're reliable, keep reading.



The role

You run the day-to-day of my social media. You take my videos and teachings, turn them into posts and short clips, publish them on a schedule, and talk to the people who comment. First you learn my world. Then you carry it to the feed.



What you'll do

• Learn my method. Take my courses, take notes, and send me your notes. You're a student first, so your posts sound like me and speak to my clients' hurts, pains, and desires.

• Post consistently across
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, on a simple content calendar.

• Turn my videos and teachings into short clips and reels. I use OpusClip

• Make clean, simple graphics in Canva.

• Optimize my Youtube Clips for more views.

• Schedule posts ahead so the channels never go quiet.

• Reply to comments and DMs, and engage with our audience like a real person.

• Pull real customer language from our testimonials library for captions and hooks.

• Track the basics: reach, engagement, follows, and what's working.



How we work

Outcomes are the measure, and the clock verifies the investment. I don't micromanage, and I don't tell you when to work. You'll track your time so you're paid for every hour you put in, but I'm paying for what you produce.

Each shift, sign in and sign out with a short report: what you learned, what you accomplished, and your notes. Hours are flexible and results-based. Be available to overlap with me in your mornings and evenings. I'm on US Central time, and no graveyard shift.



You're required at our weekly tea
eting. That one is part of the job, not optional.



Who I'm looking for

• Reliable. You post every day you're scheduled to, without me chasing you.

• Honest and accountable. You tie your hours to what you produced, and you speak your mind.

• Someone who believes people can heal and wants to help them.

• Organized. You keep a calendar and you don't let the channels go dark.

• In it for the long haul, with raises tied to results.



Skills you need

• Hands-on experience running social media for a business or brand.

• Editing short clips and reels for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

• Canva for simple graphics.

• A scheduling tool such as Meta Business Suite, Later, or Buffer.

• Clear written English for captions and replies.

• Comfort with AI tools for speed. But you do the thinking and the learning yourself. A tool won't make you good at this, and leaning on it cheats you out of the skill.



Nice to have

• Experience in coaching, wellness, personal development, or mental health niches.

• Basic video editing (CapCut or similar), and a portfolio of accounts you've helped grow.



What you get

A long-term role with raises tied to results. Pay is discussed in the interview and sent by PayPal twice a month, on the 1st and the 16th. And you'll learn a method you can use on yourself and the people you love for the rest of your life.



How to apply



Start your message with the word PEACE so I know you read this all the way through. Then send me:

1. A short note on who you are and why this mission speaks to you.

2. Links to social accounts you've run or grown.

3. A couple of sample clips or posts you made yourself.

4. The tools you use to create and schedule.



Strong applicants may be asked to do a short paid test. I read every honest application.

title: Calling All Accountants & Finance Controllers! WE WANT YOU
description:
We're a fast-growing digital marketing agency looking for a Financial Controller to fully own our finance function — the books, the cash, and the numbers behind every decision we make. You'll report directly to the founder, take bookkeeping, payroll, and reporting off his plate entirely, and act as his right hand on everything financial as we scale across three countries.



This is not a data-entry seat inside a big finance team. You are the finance team — with the mandate, tools, and direct access to build the function properly.



About us



OPT Digital is a Wellington, New Zealand-based agency helping local trades and home service businesses grow through search — across New Zealand, Australia, and the United States. We've grown quickly into a seven-figure run rate, we operate in three currencies (NZD, USD, AUD), and our goal by the end of 2026 is to be the most trusted name in Local SEO for service businesses in our markets.



One thing that makes us different: we build our own internal tools. Every department at OPT runs on custom dashboards and automations we've built in-house, and finance will be no exception — you'll work directly with the founder to build the finance dashboard and automations that remove the grind from your role.



Why this role exists



Right now, the founder is doing the reconciliation, payroll, and reporting himself. At our size, that's a bottleneck — and it's about to become a real problem as we scale. We need someone to take full ownership of the finance function: keep the books immaculate, keep cash flowing in on time, run payroll without a hitch, and give the founder numbers he can make decisions from the same day he asks.



If you've been a strong bookkeeper or senior accountant and you're ready to step up into a controller seat — where you own the function rather than execute someone else's process — this is that role.



What you'll own



1. The books. Day-to-day bookkeeping and reconciliation in Xero across bank feeds, Stripe, and other payment platforms. Accurate, consistent transaction coding. A chart of accounts restructured to reflect how the business actually operates, so reporting means something. A disciplined month-end close on a consistent rhythm — the books never fall behind.



2. The cash. Accounts receivable end to end: invoices organised and QA'd with the relevant account managers before they go out, overdue invoices chased the 
nt they slip, and follow-through until they're paid. Payroll for employees and contractors across multiple countries, run correctly and on time, reconciled back to the books. You're the reason money owed to us actually arrives and money we owe goes out cleanly.



3. The insight. P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow reporting on demand and at month-end. Cash flow and financial forecasts maintained and reviewed with the founder regularly. Spend analysis across the chart of accounts — you flag where we're overspending, where margins are drifting, and where cash pinch points are coming before they arrive. When something looks off, you say so early and plainly.



Who this role is for





You have 5+ years in bookkeeping/accounting, ideally including time as a finance manager, senior accountant, or controller for a business (or clients) doing seven figures annually

You have deep, current, hands-on Xero expertise — reconciliation, coding, chart of accounts, payroll, reporting. This is non-negotiable

Your fundamentals are rock solid: double-entry, accruals, and a genuine understanding of how the numbers connect

You've run payroll yourself, end to end, and reconciled it accurately

You're comfortable chasing money — following up overdue invoices firmly and professionally, and coordinating with account managers so nothing falls through the cracks

You can build and maintain a forecast, read what the numbers are saying, and explain it in plain English to a non-accountant

You communicate clearly in written English and can work directly with a founder without hand-holding

Strong bonus: CPA/CA qualification, NZ or AU accounting/payroll/tax experience, or multi-currency work across NZD, USD, and AUD





What we offer





$1,500–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience — and we'll go above the band for a qualified CPA/CA who can lead deeper analysis and forecasting

13th month pay

HMO allowance after your probation period

Paid time off plus paid Philippine public holidays

Fully remote — work from anywhere in the Philippines

Direct access to the founder, and a genuine seat at the table as we make growth decisions

Custom tools and automations built around your role — you tell us what would make the job easier, and we build it together

A finance function that is yours to own and shape, with a clear path to a head-of-finance seat as we scale





How to apply



We read every application that follows these instructions — and we skip every one that doesn't.





Use the subject line: CONTROLLER — [Your Name]

In your application, answer these three questions (a few sentences each is fine):



What's the largest set of books you've managed — roughly what annual revenue, and what did you own within it?

Describe your month-end close process in Xero, step by step, as you actually run it.

Tell us about a time you spotted a financial problem before it became one. What did you see, and what did you do?







Optional but strongly encouraged: include a short Loom or video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and walking us through your Xero experience. Applicants who do this go to the top of the pile.





We're reviewing applications now and will move quickly with the right candidates.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor (Full-Time) - Podcast + Business Content



LINK TO POSTING HTML: View this posting in a file by downloading the HTML file and viewing it in your web browser: 



We produce weekly video content for two brands: Stripe It Podcast (business coaching) and Laser Pavement Solutions (a pavement maintenance company). We need one editor to own it all, on a predictable weekly schedule, for one fixed monthly price. We don't track hours. We care about finished work, delivered on time, at a rate we agree on up front.



What you'd be producing every week:

- 1 podcast episode: full edit for YouTube plus an audio export for Buzzsprout, with a 15-30s highlight cold open and a 5-10s branded intro

- 3 short-form clips: vertical, captioned, hook-first, for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, mostly pulled from the podcast and long-form videos

- 1 long-form video every 2 weeks: 10-20 minute instructional pieces in a follow-along, on-screen teaching style, with light to medium graphics and screen recordings

- 1 Laser Pavement short-form clip per week: same spec as the podcast clips, for our pavement company



That's the core recurring bundle. Some months we'll ask for extra pieces beyond it, so we want a simple per-piece rate for additional short-form clips, additional long-form videos, and additional Laser Pavement clips.



There are two optional add-ons if they fit your strengths:



OPTION 1: Posting and distribution: uploading and scheduling finished content across platforms plus writing captions and descriptions, handled through delegated access, never shared passwords. 



OPTION 2: a behind-the-scenes vlog, roughly 20 minutes, motion-graphics heavy, styled after the "Behind the Diary" channel (Steven Bartlett, Diary of a CEO). If you have strong motion graphics or VFX skills, this is where they matter most.



Style references so you know what we're aiming for:

Short-form: Alex Hormozi, Dan Martell, Gary Vaynerchuk

Long-form: Alex Hormozi, Nick Saraev (especially his follow-along teaching style)

Podcast edit: Impaulsive

Vlog: Behind the Diary



How to apply. Send us four numbers.

1. One fixed monthly price for the entire core bundle. This is the number that matters most.

2. A simple per-piece rate for each add-on. If you can't take on extra pieces beyond the bundle, tell us that instead.

3. A separate price for each optional service you want to take on, if any.

4. Your revision policy. How many rounds are included per deliverable type, and what happens after that.



Shortlisted candidates will be paid for a short test project before any long-term commitment. We believe in paying for your time.



If this sounds like a fit, apply with your rates, a link to your portfolio, and a short note on which of the optional services (if any) play to your strengths.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success and Tech Support) - $900 Base + Performance Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- $900/month guaranteed base

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.

(9) Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both administrative support and marketing coordination, with approximately 70% of the role focused on marketing activities and 30% on administration.



POSITION PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES



The primary responsibility of this position is to coordinate and execute the company's marketing initiatives while providing administrative support to ensure the smooth operation of business activities and events. This role is responsible for managing marketing campaigns, CRM systems, content creation, and digital marketing activities, while also supporting event coordination, administrative processes, stakeholder communication, and operational tasks. 3. Creating compelling content across multiple channels including
s, blogs, and social media.

4. Assisting with SEO, analytics, and marketing reporting to improve campaign performance.

5. Coordinating company events and activities from planning through to completion.

6. Providing administrative support including documentation, scheduling, record management, and stakeholder communication.

7. Supporting continuous improvement of marketing and administrative processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES



Marketing Coordination

• Set up, manage, and maintain the CRM system for marketing and sales purposes.

• Plan, execute, and manage marketing campaigns and initiatives end-to-end.

• Develop and execute
 marketing campaigns (EDMs) using CRM and
 platforms.

• Write engaging copy for blogs, newsletters, social media, and other marketing channels.

• Assist with creating marketing graphics, layouts, and visual content where needed.

• Build and manage CRM automations to streamline marketing workflows and client engagement.

• Monitor marketing campaign performance, prepare reports, and recommend improvements.

• Identify new marketing opportunities and independently drive initiatives to completion.

• Undertake general admin tasks to assist the wider team during low marketing periods.

• Maintain accurate records of marketing activities, assets, and campaigns.



Administration & Event Coordination

• Coordinate company events, workshops, classes, and promotional activities from planning through to completion.

• Liaise with venues, suppliers, service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful event delivery.

• Assist with scheduling meetings, appointments, and key business activities.

• Provide professional and timely communication with clients, partners, suppliers, and event attendees.

• Support reporting, data entry, and administrative projects as required.

• Undertake ad hoc administrative and operational tasks as directed by management.



KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES



• Proven experience in marketing coordination, administration, or a similar role.

• Experience coordinating events and managing logistics.

• Experience in CRM management, marketing automation, and data-driven marketing.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong copywriting ability.

• Knowledge of SEO best practices and content optimisation.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Google Workspace cloud-based tools.

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

title: SENIOR SEO LEAD
description:
Role Overview



We are hiring an SEO Team Lead to own and grow our SEO department.



This is not just a technical role.



You will:



Lead SEO strategy across multiple clients



Manage and mentor SEO specialists and content writers



Build scalable SEO systems and processes



Connect SEO performance to real business outcomes



Work closely with the founder and leadership team



You must think strategically and execute consistently.



Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Planning



Develop 6–12 month SEO roadmaps



Create cluster and topical authority strategies



Build local SEO strategies for service-based businesses



Align SEO with revenue and lead targets



2. Team Leadership



Manage and mentor SEO specialists



Oversee content writers and editors



Review and improve briefs before execution



Run internal SEO meetings



Improve team processes and documentation



You will be responsible for performance and quality.



3. Technical SEO Oversight



Site architecture



Internal linking strategies



Schema implementation



Core Web Vitals



Indexation and crawl management



Redirect and migration planning



GBP optimization and local signals



4. Data & Reporting



Use GA4 and Search Console daily



Track conversions and attribution



Translate SEO metrics into business impact



Identify performance drops and growth opportunities



Present results confidently to clients



5. Process & Systems



Build repeatable SEO SOPs



Implement sprint-based SEO workflows



Use AI tools to improve efficiency



Improve reporting systems





Maintain task accountability through ClickUp or similar tools



Requirements

Experience



4+ years in SEO



Experience leading or mentoring a team



Proven local SEO results



Experience with service-based or local businesses



Agency Experience is a must



Skills



Strong technical SEO knowledge



Ability to create scalable content systems



Clear communication skills



Comfortable leading client calls



Strong analytical mindset



Familiar with AI tools and automation



Work Structure



Remote position



Must overlap at least 3–5 hours with Canada West Coast business hours



Ability to attend strategy calls during PST time zone when required



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who:



Thinks like a business owner



Cares about measurable impact



Takes ownership without being micromanaged



Can challenge weak strategy respectfully



Is calm under pressure



Wants to build something long-term



This is a leadership position, not a junior SEO role.



What You Will Gain



Direct impact on a growing agency



Leadership authority in the SEO department



Freedom to build systems



Opportunity to scale with the company



Competitive compensation based on experience and performance



How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction about your SEO philosophy



One example of a 6-month SEO roadmap you created



A sample content brief



A description of a technical SEO issue you solved



Your time zone and availability overlap with PST
